windows_dark.notes: AUDIT 40 (1): downgraded to review. Reproduced: native_dark6 equals groupbox-rest and groupbox-disabled everywhere outside the caption (180 px, all inside the caption box 21,11 to 53,22; frame #DCDCDC, 11.9 : 1). But the control's own picture group_box.png draws the frame #707070 (a choice; the only native dark evidence is #DCDCDC, and no dark TcxGroupBox exists), and at 1x its horizontal edges sit on half pixels (top rows 44 and 100, bottom two rows of #484848, 1.8 : 1 each), so the 3.3 : 1 line holds only at 1.5x and on the vertical edges. The white caption and the #9D9D9D disabled caption have no capture behind them either: groupbox-disabled is pixel for pixel the rest capture (black caption). The row's own old rule (audit 17: a derived row with a real native dark capture that it does not reproduce is review) applies to group_box.png. Raise when the derived frame is a crisp whole-pixel line of the capture's colour, or the maintainer accepts #707070 against the #DCDCDC capture as a stated decision. (Radio Windows Dark held: its marks are 0 px off in all ten native dark captures, the disabled caption #CCCCCC is the capture's own, and the enabled white matches the same capture's white static text.) | ROUND 80 (review to matched; audit 39 (2) closed): the caption is light. native_dark6 draws 'Group' white (#9D9D9D disabled) on #202020 instead of the capture's black, and the derived group_box.png frame is the 3.3 : 1 #707070 line (it was #333333, 1.29 : 1) through the radio group's dark_group_line. Measured (scripts/looks_dark_whole.py, groupbox-rest and groupbox-disabled against native_dark6, whole 200 x 90 capture): everything below the caption row (frame, body text 'Inside the group') structure off 0, text off 0; the only differing pixels are the caption's own ink (bbox 21,11 to 53,22), by design. Viewed native_dark6.png and group_box.png. Recorded deviation: caption colour (white against black). | AUDIT 39 (2): downgraded to review. The row's picture native_dark6.png draws the caption 'Group' black (0,0,0) on #202020 over the frame line, rest and disabled: about 1.1 : 1, unreadable when viewed; the row's own gap already says so and also that the frame is below the 3 : 1 bar and 'the status stays started'. Matching a capture does not make the picture readable. Raise when the caption is light. | ROUND 35 (review to matched, whole native control: native_dark6 draws the 200 x 90 Button group box (1 px #DCDCDC frame with the caption gap, black caption Group, white static Inside the group at 28,36; the disabled capture is identical): groupbox-rest 0 px off, groupbox-disabled 0 px off, glyphs counted. The caption is black on #202020, i.e. as unreadable as natively; it is the native look, built the way list_box was (a native-geometry sheet), and v3's own TcxGroupBox is DevExpress-drawn, so the derived group_box.png sheet is unchanged and still shows the muted frame) Rule (scripts/looks_dark_whole.py): the whole native 1x capture, every pixel, best whole-pixel placement in our sheet; off = any channel over 2 levels; glyph pixels counted (audit-8 glyph rule: none set aside). | AUDIT 17 (matched to review): groupbox-rest and -disabled are real native dark captures (an unthemed frame #DCDCDC with a black caption on the dark client) and the derived sheet draws a muted frame: 1670 px counted off per capture at best placement, not a rounding difference. The round 15 note that no usable reference exists was about the caption being unreadable natively, not about the capture being absent. Rule: a derived row with a real native dark capture that it does not reproduce is review. | DERIVED, not captured (maintainer accepted 2026-10-17 after viewing the sheets): no native or v3 dark reference exists for this control. Round 15: no real dark reference exists for this control (the native group box frame stays light #DCDCDC in dark). The dark sheets are checked against the matched light ones instead: scripts/looks_derive_dark.py: the dark sheet is a consistent light-to-dark colour map of the light one, a pixel being off when its dark colour differs from the dark colour most of its light colour's pixels take by more than 2 levels: group_box 1 px outside the text zone of 1880 off px, group_box_dialog 1512 of 7961 The frame (#333333 against the page 1.29 : 1) is below the 3 : 1 border bar.

material.notes: AUDIT 40 (2): downgraded to review. Held: whole-pixel bar (rows 38 to 85 = 48, x 20 to 499), titles 24 to 87, 88 to 151, 152 to 219, 220 to 283 (12 px padding, 64 minimum, Search 68), text 12 px in, hover e2dce6 and pressed ded8e2 (dark 312e36, 35323a) = 8 % and 10 % of on-surface, panel flush at y 80 under the bar ending at 79, rows 48, separators one row (cac4d0), disabled 38 %. Fails against menu_anchor.dart: the vertical panel is IntrinsicWidth (_MenuPanelState, _intrinsicCrossSize) with no minimum or maximum in _MenuDefaultsM3, and a row is padding 12, label, 12 (horizontalPadding in _MenuItemLabel), shortcut, padding 12. The widest row here, Increase Quantity (ink 110) and Num + (41), gives about 187 px; the picture is 280 (the M3 cap, not a source default), with 105 px between label and shortcut. The shortcut gap in navigation.e is 24 plus two 8 px flex gaps. Also: the dividers are 17 rows (panel 338 high; Flutter's Divider is 16), the shortcut is drawn muted where Flutter's Text inherits on-surface (M3 tokens say on-surface-variant: the two sources differ), and the tint on the open Cards title (10 %) has no line in menu_anchor.dart. Raise when the panel hugs its widest row (12 / 12 spacing) or the width is recorded as a deviation against Flutter. | ROUND 80 (s): standard density chosen and measured with the own comparer against Flutter menu_anchor.dart (_MenuBarDefaultsM3, _MenuButtonDefaultsM3 with _scaledPadding 12 at the standard density of Android, _MenuDefaultsM3). Bar 48 high on whole rows (32 to 79 in the open sheet), titles 12 px side padding and 64 x 48 minimum (File 64, Cards 64, Search 68, View 64 wide, text ink 12 px in), hover and pressed tones exact: light e2dce6 and ded8e2 over f3edf7, dark 312e36 and 35323a over 211f26 (on-surface 8 % and 10 %), keyboard focus the same as pressed. Menu panel hangs flush under its title (Flutter's menuPaddingOffset is zero, was 2 px), no slide-in (it left the panel on a fraction of a pixel), 280 wide, rows 48 and hovered row 201 to 248 on whole pixels, separators one row each (cac4d0, dark 49454f) at 192 and 305, panel f3edf7 equal to the bar. Hover and pressed cells now target the View title so the bar keeps its 480 width in all four cells. Light and dark viewed. flutter-compare-s.md.
gaps: Audit 40: the panel is 280 wide where Flutter's IntrinsicWidth panel is about 187 (label to shortcut 105 px, Flutter 12); dividers 17 rows against 16
Recorded deviations: the menu shade is level 2 (M3 token) where Flutter paints 3; the bar fills its container where Flutter's MenuBar hugs its content
The Android bar is the Flutter / desktop idiom of the M3 menu: M3 has no menu bar component, the bar height and padding are Flutter's published MenuBar defaults
No Flutter MenuBar reference image exists: the numbers are the published source, the hover and pressed frames are not compared with a Flutter frame
Submenu cascades and checked or radio items are not drawn in the sheet

cupertino.notes: AUDIT 40 (3): downgraded to review. Held: the sizes (17, 22, 34, 13, 12; ink heights within 1 px of PIL Segoe UI at the cited size in all 12 cells, widths within 4 px) and the HIG Typography numbers are the published ones (Body 17, Headline 17 semibold, Title 2 22, Large Title 34, Footnote 13, Caption 1 12). Fails: the cell 'Headline 17 semibold' (Deck Properties) is drawn in Segoe UI Regular, not semibold and not bold: summed ink coverage 381 against 391 for Regular, 514 for Semibold, 672 for Bold at 17 px, ink width 117 against 118 / 122 / 127. The note's deviation line (semibold is drawn in Segoe UI Bold) is true only for Large Title (Library: 1168 against 1167 for Bold). A cited property of the row is not reproduced and the stated deviation is wrong for it. Raise when the Headline cell is semibold or bold and the deviation line says what is drawn. | ROUND 80 (s), shapes only (type sizes; the typeface is Segoe UI, a stand-in for SF). Cited, read from the published HIG Typography page (HIG pages read from developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/design/human-interface-guidelines/typography): iOS Body 17, Headline 17 semibold, Title 2 22, Large Title 34 bold, Footnote 13, Caption 1 12; macOS Body 13. Measured with an own comparer: the ink box of each of the 12 cells against Segoe UI rendered by PIL at the cited size, same string: heights equal within 1 px in every cell (17: 14 vs 13, 22: 18 vs 17, 34: 35 vs 34, 13: 10 to 14 vs 9 to 13, 12: 12 vs 12), widths 0 to 4 px narrower (Library 110 vs 114, Deck Properties 117 vs 122: hinting and the bold stand-in). Light and dark identical, all cells viewed. Colours are not claimed: the HIG now lists iOS 26 system colours (blue 0088FF) where this look follows iOS 17 / macOS 14 (007AFF), and it publishes no label or secondary label values. flutter-compare-s.md.
gaps: Audit 40: the Headline cell (17 pt semibold) is drawn in Segoe UI Regular (ink coverage 381 against 514 semibold, 672 bold); only Large Title is bold
Recorded deviations: Segoe UI replaces SF Pro; semibold is drawn in Segoe UI Bold; colours are iOS 17 / macOS 14 values, the current HIG lists iOS 26 values (system blue 0088FF)
Link underline and mnemonics are not drawn (Apple links are not underlined)
Text styles are the iOS defaults; macOS uses 13 pt for body (shown in one cell)
Corners are circular arcs, not the continuous curve; no blur or vibrancy
